summary: dnf5 options: name specifiers (versions, URLs, paths, provided files), nobest, releasever, security-only updates, skip_broken and sslverify.
questions: How do I install a package version greater than 1.0 with dnf5?
How do I apply only security updates with dnf5?
How do I install from a repo with a self-signed certificate in dnf5?
How do I skip unavailable packages in dnf5?

answer_card.title: dnf5 parameters (part 4)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (alias `pkg`): `name-1.0`, `name >= 1.0` (spaces needed), `*` with latest, RPM URL/path, or provided file path
- `security` (no): security updates only with `latest`
- `skip_broken` (no)
- `sslverify` (yes): set false for self-signed repos
- `releasever`, `nobest`
